Nuk • AI Assistant
Consumer orders are typically shipped within 2 days.
After shipment, delivery times are as follows:
- Eastern USA: 2–6 days (Florida: 5–8 days)
- Central/Western USA: 3–6 days
If you have not received tracking information after more than a couple of days, your order may still be processing or awaiting carrier pickup. Please let me know if you require further clarification.
